title: No One-Size-Fits-All: Adaptive Code Editing with Feature-Based Strategy Selection
title_zh: 没有万能方案：基于特征化策略选择的自适应代码编辑

paragraphs.en: 总结：研究团队构建CEBench并分析三种代码编辑策略的优劣，提出能按任务特征自适应选择最优策略的Ace框架，显著提升性能并降低成本。 Large language models have shown strong potential in automating code editing (CE) tasks, yet most existing systems rely on a fixed CE strategy (i.e., one-step, search-replace, and plan-apply) across diverse scenarios. In practice, CE tasks vary widely in code context, edit locality, and semantic complexity, causing no single strategy to perform consistently well. Moreover, systematic studies on the relationship between strategies and CE tasks remain scarce, limiting further optimization of LLM-based code editing strategies. To address this gap, we construct CEBench, comprising 500 real-world CE tasks curated from SWE-bench. Then we compare three representative CE strategies (one-step, search-replace, plan-apply). Our study reveals two key findings: (1) each strategy exhibits distinct advantages for specific CE tasks, with no universal optimality; (2) strategy effectiveness is significantly influenced by four core task features: total lines of code, modification type, modification scope, and task type. Motivated by these findings, we propose Ace, an adaptive code editing framework that dynamically selects optimal CE strategies based on task features. Unlike classifier-based or instruction-prompting approaches, Ace employs a fine-tuned LLM that learns feature-strategy mappings from empirical data to recommend strategies with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on our CEBench-verified show that Ace outperforms state-of-the-art baselines: it boosts Pass@1 by 21.7% while reducing token consumption by 27.3% compared to the best baseline (AutoCodeRover). Our strategy selector achieves 72.6% selection accuracy with 69.9% rationale accuracy (Cohen's Kappa = 0.807), providing transparent and trustworthy decision-making for developers.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：研究团队构建CEBench并分析三种代码编辑策略的优劣，提出能按任务特征自适应选择最优策略的Ace框架，显著提升性能并降低成本。大语言模型在自动化代码编辑（CE）任务中展现出强大潜力，然而现有大多数系统在多样场景下都依赖固定的CE策略（即单步式、搜索-替换式和计划-执行式）。 在实践中，CE任务在代码上下文、编辑局部性和语义复杂度方面差异很大，导致没有任何单一策略能够始终表现良好。 此外，针对策略与CE任务之间关系的系统性研究仍然稀缺，限制了基于大语言模型的代码编辑策略的进一步优化。 为填补这一空白，我们构建了CEBench，其中包含从SWE-bench精选出的500个真实世界CE任务。 随后我们比较了三种具有代表性的CE策略（单步式、搜索-替换式、计划-执行式）。 我们的研究揭示了两个关键发现：（1）每种策略在特定CE任务上都展现出独特优势，不存在普遍最优性；（2）策略的有效性显著受到四个核心任务特征的影响：代码总行数、修改类型、修改范围和任务类型。 受这些发现启发，我们提出Ace，一个基于任务特征动态选择最优CE策略的自适应代码编辑框架。 与基于分类器或指令提示的方法不同，Ace采用一个经过微调的大语言模型，从经验数据中学习特征-策略映射，以可解释的依据推荐策略。 在我们验证过的CEBench上的大量实验表明，Ace优于最先进的基线方法：与最佳基线（AutoCodeRover）相比，它将Pass@1提升了21.7%，同时将token消耗降低了27.3%。 我们的策略选择器达到72.6%的选择准确率和69.9%的依据准确率（Cohen's Kappa = 0.807），为开发者提供透明且可信的决策。
